correctness.rationale: PASS: On grid {0,1}, exact pre-update y=(1-eta)x+eta b and floor(Ky)/K upward probability yield transition p=floor(K eta b)/K, q=ceil(K eta(1-b))/K, 0<p+q<=1 with q>0. Stationary pi1=p/(p+q) is unique and chain converges geometrically even in absorbing-zero regime. Ideal exact-probability rounding has stationary Bernoulli(b). The one-sided total-variation discrepancy b-p/(p+q) is bounded by min(1,1/(K eta)) through integer/fractional decomposition v=Keta=n+theta, vb=k+u; letting b↑1/v or b↑1 proves sharp supremum. Independent exact rational tests at K=1,4,8,16 and representative eta and 999 targets each verified all values and asymptotic approach. The bit threshold K eta→∞ follows exactly. Domain 0<eta,b<1 and K=2^r includes K=1.
